title: Installation Appointment Rules — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Installation appointments for Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty sets are booked only for a set that has been bought and not yet mounted.

1. **Status.** The set must be in status ordered when an installation appointment is booked.
2. **Hold period.** The appointment must fall no later than the end of the order hold period counted from the purchase of the ordered set. Calendar days are counted from the day after the anchor date, so the anchor date plus the number of days is the last qualifying date. The anchor is the purchase date on the set's ticket and the number of days is the line's hold after purchase.
3. **Notice and horizon.** The slot must start at least the line's minimum notice in hours after the booking is made and no more than the line's booking horizon in days after the booking date, at a store whose bays are open at that time; the bay is reserved for the line's bay time per appointment.
4. **Special orders.** A special-order size cannot be booked earlier than the line's special-order lead time in business days (Monday to Friday, excluding the store's published holidays) after the purchase date.
5. **Moves.** Moving an appointment books a new slot as a new booking; the bookings on the set may not exceed one plus the line's appointment moves allowed, after which the order is cancelled and re-bought as a new ticket.
6. **Late arrival.** A customer who has not arrived the line's late-release minutes after the slot start loses the slot, which counts as used.

**Hold-period boundary (hypothetical 14-day hold, purchase on day 0):** an appointment on day 14 qualifies; an appointment on day 15 does not.

**Moves (hypothetical line allowing 2 moves):** a set may carry up to 3 bookings in all; a fourth is not booked.
